description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of 'git merge --abort' in various scenarios. It sets up a repository with different branches and conflicts, performs merge operations, and verifies proper handling of aborting in-progress merges under different conditions.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup of the repository with multiple branches and commits.

methods.name: fails without MERGE_HEAD (unstarted merge)
methods.description: Tests that 'git merge --abort' fails when no merge is in progress.

methods.name: fails without MERGE_HEAD (completed merge)
methods.description: Tests that 'git merge --abort' fails when a merge has already completed.

methods.name: Forget previous merge
methods.description: Resets the repository to pre-merge state.

methods.name: Abort after --no-commit
methods.description: Performs a merge without commit and then aborts to test cleanup.

methods.name: Abort after conflicts
methods.description: Creates a conflicting merge and then aborts.

methods.name: Clean merge with dirty index fails
methods.description: Tests abort behavior when index is dirty during a clean merge.

methods.name: Conflicting merge with dirty index fails
methods.description: Tests abort behavior with conflicts and a dirty index.

methods.name: Reset index (but preserve worktree changes)
methods.description: Resets the index to pre-merge state.

methods.name: Abort clean merge with non-conflicting dirty worktree
methods.description: Tests abort during clean merge with dirty worktree.

methods.name: Abort conflicting merge with non-conflicting dirty worktree
methods.description: Tests abort during conflicting merge with dirty worktree.

methods.name: Reset worktree changes
methods.description: Resets working directory to previous state.

methods.name: Fail clean merge with conflicting dirty worktree
methods.description: Tests abort behavior with conflicts and dirty worktree.

methods.name: Fail conflicting merge with conflicting dirty worktree
methods.description: Tests abort with conflicts and dirty worktree.

methods.name: Reset worktree changes
methods.description: Reverts working directory to clean state.

methods.name: Fail clean merge with matching dirty worktree
methods.description: Tests abort with matching modifications in worktree.

methods.name: Fail conflicting merge with matching dirty worktree
methods.description: Tests abort with conflicts and matching worktree changes.
